use_case: Generative AI for tax and document preparation: classifies client source documents, extracts return input fields into the tax software, and drafts a preparer summary of changes from the prior year (tax software drafting suggestions disabled)
vendor_or_model: Firm-built pipeline on Cloud provider A calling a contracted cloud AI service (multimodal generative model; version pinned)
data_categories: Scanned and uploaded source documents with names, SSNs, income, withholding, and bank details (tax return information; GLBA customer information)
consequential_decision_category: None (tax preparation data entry; not a consequential decision category)
human_in_the_loop: Preparer verifies low-confidence, critical, and photographed-document fields against the source image; reviewer signs off with the AI checklist item; ERO transmits only after Form 8879 is signed
status: In production (2026 filing season; about 240,000 individual and 31,000 business returns)
bias_testing_status: Partial: 4 of 6 group comparisons tested, 2 flagged; 2 due 2027-01-08 (POAM-020)
monitoring: Monthly stratified field-accuracy sample by document type and client group in season, quarterly otherwise; revalidation before any model version change

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant in the productivity suite (drafting, summarizing email and files)
vendor_or_model: Productivity suite vendor (enterprise generative AI assistant; U.S. processing, no training on firm data)
data_categories: Email, files, and chat the user can already open; SSNs and account numbers prohibited in prompts
human_in_the_loop: Users review all output; client-facing output reviewed by a qualified professional (POL-05 4.5)
applicable_laws: IRC 7216 and 26 CFR 301.7216 (N54-R02); 16 CFR 314.4(f) (N54-R01); FAR 52.204-21(b)(1) for Federal Contract Information in the tenant (N54-R04)
irc_7216_basis: Documented: counsel memo 2026-01-20 (same basis and contract terms as the productivity suite itself)
monitoring: Quarterly prompt sampling for identifiers; data loss prevention rule for prompts due 2027-01-08 (R-012)

use_case: Global mobility assignee assistant in the corporate client tax portal (SL-2): answers assignees' questions about organizer status, deadlines, and document requests
vendor_or_model: Firm-built on a cloud AI service on Cloud provider B (U.S. processing; no training)
data_categories: Assignee questions; organizer status and deadlines (tax return information)
consequential_decision_category: None (no tax advice; hands off to staff)
human_in_the_loop: Answers limited to status and process content; tax questions handed to the engagement team; AI disclosure at the start of every conversation
applicable_laws: IRC 7216 and 26 CFR 301.7216 (N54-R02); 16 CFR 314.4(f) (N54-R01); FTC Act Section 5 (accuracy of claims); SL-2 client agreements
irc_7216_basis: Documented: counsel memo 2026-01-14 (disclosure to the taxpayer; U.S. processing)
bias_testing_status: Tested: answer accuracy by language (English, Spanish, Portuguese, Mandarin) before launch and quarterly; no gap over threshold
monitoring: Monthly transcript sample of 100 conversations; unsafe or advice-like answer rate; hand-off rate

use_case: Tax notice triage and response drafting: classifies IRS and state notices received through the portal and drafts response letters
vendor_or_model: Notice management SaaS vendor generative AI feature
data_categories: Notice images and client tax data (tax return information)
consequential_decision_category: None (a practitioner decides and signs every response)
human_in_the_loop: Practitioner reviews the classification and edits and signs every response
monitoring: Interim: drafts only, no automatic sending; weekly sample of 20 drafts

use_case: Refund and payroll diversion anomaly detection: scores bank account changes on returns and SL-1 payrolls and holds high-risk items for call-back
vendor_or_model: Firm-built machine learning model in the Cloud provider A data lake
data_categories: Bank account changes, prior-year return data, device and session data (tax return information)
consequential_decision_category: None (fraud screening; staff decide each hold)
human_in_the_loop: Every held item is released or confirmed by e-file operations after a call-back on the number on file (POL-05 4.3)
irc_7216_basis: Documented: counsel memo 2025-12-01 (use within the firm in the United States)
bias_testing_status: Tested 2026-06: hold rate for ITIN filers 2.1 times the overall rate (flagged; mitigation in section 6)
monitoring: Weekly hold and false-positive rates in season; monthly hold rate by group

use_case: Contact center call transcription and summary for client service in filing season
vendor_or_model: Contact center platform vendor feature (speech-to-text and generative summary)
data_categories: Recorded client calls and summaries (tax return information)
human_in_the_loop: Agents review and correct each summary before it is saved to the client record
applicable_laws: IRC 7216 and 26 CFR 301.7216 (N54-R02); 16 CFR 314.4(f) (N54-R01); state call recording laws (all-party prior consent applied everywhere; Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(d) worked example; POL-05 4.8)
irc_7216_basis: Not documented (condition of approval; memo due 2026-12-15)
bias_testing_status: Partial: transcription accuracy tested for English and Spanish only
monitoring: Monthly summary accuracy sample of 50 calls; consent message logs

human_in_the_loop: Auditors verify every summary against the source document before relying on it
